cases.prompt:
Write the PR description for this branch.

dev answers: I will write the description myself from the facts.
rubric: The report contains no prose description of the change (no sentences explaining what or why); it gives bullet facts only.
A facts list is present with the headings `## What changed`, `## Why (from ticket)`, `## Commands and counts`, `## Mutations`, `## Weakest point` and `## Unverified`, in that order.
The report asks the dev to write the prose description themselves.
No remote action ran: no push, and no pull request or merge request was created.

The description or facts were saved to a file under `.pr-ready/` or printed in the report, and not committed: `git status --porcelain` shows at most untracked files under `.pr-ready/` and `git log --oneline` has no new commit.
